messages:
Nico: heads up 101 about the evals upload empty state copy. current: `Upload a prompt set to start evaluating model quality.`
Nico: support reported a couple of customers thought 'prompt set' was a file format. can we clarify what types of uploads are supported?
Hannah: good catch. we should list examples and avoid jargon. maybe: 'Upload a prompts file (CSV, JSONL) or paste prompts to run evals.'
Li: +1 on examples. also recommend we avoid the word 'start' since users may think uploads kick off background jobs immediately. clarify if upload only creates a draft or triggers runs.
Nico: right — our flow is: upload creates an eval suite draft; user chooses which models to run and then starts the run. so copy must reflect that.
CopyQA: suggestion: header: 'Create an evaluation suite' body: 'Upload prompts (CSV, JSONL) or paste them to create an eval draft. You can run evaluations after selecting models and settings.' CTA: 'Upload prompts'
Hannah: i like 'Create an evaluation suite' rather than 'Upload' for the header 101 since it's more outcome-focused. body is explicit and short. CTA 'Upload prompts' is fine.
Li: accessibility nit: ensure the CTA has aria-label 'Upload prompts to create evaluation suite' so screen readers get the action + result. Also avoid combining parenthesis in the main body for clarity; put the formats in a separate sentence: 'We support CSV and JSONL.'
Nico: updated copy proposal: header: 'Create an evaluation suite' body: 'Upload prompts to create an evaluation draft. Supported file types: CSV, JSONL. Or paste prompts directly.' CTA: 'Upload prompts'
CopyQA: maybe reorder: 'Upload prompts (CSV, JSONL) or paste them to create an evaluation draft.' keeps action-first and reduces sentences. but either way is fine.
LocalizationBot: note: add translator context: 'evaluation draft' means a saved suite of prompts that does not automatically start evaluation runs. Avoid literal translations of 'suite' without context.
Hannah: can we also add a tooltip / microcopy by the CTA: 'You can start runs after selecting models.' small and low-contrast.
Li: keep tooltip short: 'Run evaluations after choosing models.' and ensure it's included in the accessibility tree (aria-describedby) when focused.
Nico: i'll update the design mock and add the copy to the component strings: keys `evals.empty.title`, `evals.empty.body`, `evals.empty.cta`, `evals.empty.cta_tooltip`. I'll include translation notes.
CopyQA: lgtm. I'll run a quick copy QA pass once the strings land to catch any remaining ambiguity.
Nico: thanks all. filing PR now and tagging @Hannah for visual review.
